executor: Claude Code general-purpose subagent (claude-opus-5), fresh per scenario and round
reviewer: parent: request/response/rc records captured by an evaluation wrapper around the real helper, note contents, fixture hashes
method: Fixed scenarios A (delegate report vs diff), B (docs vs config with embedded secrets), C (deterministic CI log, no call expected), D (claim with absent definitions, from iter22); holdouts H (endpoint unreachable), H2 (delegation brief with a token), H3 (docs vs code with personal contact data), H4 (research claims vs citations), H5 (automated review findings vs code). Checklists frozen in scenarios.json before dispatch. Self-reported unclear points adjudicated per adjudication.md.

rounds.skill: v4 (user: use where no deterministic mechanism)
v6 (first attempt aborted by rate limit, rerun)
v9 (user: when in doubt send to Jev)
v12 (user: semantic assertions, heavy use; rewrite)
v20 (external feedback: helper snapshot/endpoint/output fixes; test lens; sufficiency assertions; reporting volume; statuses)

convergence.holdout: H5 passed (100%) at v23; H4 passed at v22
convergence.numericNote: iter26→iter27 steps equal for A–D; duration within ±15% for A, B, C, D (63→60, 70→64, 26→26, 74→66). Single runs per scenario.
convergence.previousConvergence: v19 at iter20–21 before external feedback

limitations: Requirement checklists are shown to executors, so some items can be satisfied from the checklist itself; qualitative self-reports carry most of the signal.
Adjudication of 'new defect' is by the parent; the counting rule was clarified before reading iter20 A/B (adjudication.md).
Fixtures are small and synthetic; answer quality of Jev on real project material is not measured.
Executors ran inside the Runeweave working tree; project CLAUDE.md context may have influenced data-boundary caution (seen in iter13 A).
iter16 A/B step and duration metrics arrived after the round summary and are taken from completion notifications.

trials.note: Real Jev probes run while designing v20; single calls, not a benchmark.
evaluationObservations: Scenario D: specific sufficiency 0.03–0.16 while claim answers 0.76–0.97 on the same state.
Conditional vs unconditional pair: 0.98 vs 0.29 (iter23 D).

helperTests: jev-crosscheck/tests/helper.test.mjs: 10 tests; the five feedback cases (endpoint change, question display, credential value leakage, HTTP error stream, replace-during-send) failed on the v19 helper and pass on v20+.
